blocks.text: Condo buildings in East Delta
"East Delta" is NOT an official City of Delta neighbourhood name.
Streets, schools and getting around East Delta

items.t: Working boundary only (no official boundary is published): the farm land and East Ladner urban edge east of the Ladner village core, around Ladner Trunk Road, 60B Street and Highway 17A, based on the former East Ladner Area Plan (Schedule B.1, Bylaw No. 3950) references and application addresses in City council reports.

Main roads: Highway 17A, Ladner Trunk Road and Highway 99 through the George Massey Tunnel, with Highway 17 (South Fraser Perimeter Road) to the south; TransLink route 601 runs via Ladner Exchange, Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99, and route 620 runs via Ladner Exchange, Highway 17A and Highway 17. A bus route serving the interior farm roads: UNVERIFIED.
Fraser Health describes East Delta only as farmland in Delta, noting the Good Samaritan Delta View Care Centre is located in the farmlands of East Delta.
Nearby areas: Ladner village and the Ladner sub-areas (Hawthorne, Holly, Neilsen Grove, Port Guichon) to the west; North Delta across the farm belt to the northeast; Tsawwassen to the southwest.

Where the condo stock actually concentrates: it does not —. The only strata growth on the urban edge is townhouse product on 60B Street. Schools are address-based in SD37 (K–7 elementary, 8–12 secondary, no middle tier); no sample address was run for this sub-area, so no catchment result is stated: UNVERIFIED.
Services are in Ladner: Ladner Pioneer Library, 4683 51 Street, and Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, next to Ladner Exchange.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in East Delta

items.t: Delta farm zoning: in the A1 zone (Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, s. 10.10.8), subdivision is permitted only where it complies with the OCP and has been approved under the Agricultural Land Commission Act if applicable, and the minimum lot size that may be created is 8 ha, with a home site severance exception under ALC policy; the bylaw provides one farm house per lot, a farm house maximum of 500 m², a farm home plate maximum of 3,600 m², one secondary suite inside the farm house, and one accessory farm dwelling unit of maximum 90 m² on lots of 40 ha or less or 186 m² on lots over 40 ha. A2 sets the same 8 ha subdivision minimum; A3 does not permit subdivision.

ALR housing: the ALC generally allows no more than one residence per ALR parcel; a principal residence built without an ALC application is capped at 500 m² total floor area; a secondary suite is permitted only inside the principal residence if local bylaws allow it; and one additional detached residence is permitted up to 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less or 186 m² on parcels over 40 ha — anything beyond that needs ALC approval.

blocks.text: Good to know about East Delta

items.t: The old East Ladner Area Plan no longer exists as a schedule. It was Schedule B.1 under the former OCP, Bylaw No. 3950; the consolidated OCP, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), folded the former area plans into a single Land Use Plan, and the farm part falls under the municipal-wide agricultural policies.
Check the home plate, not just the house. The A1 farm home plate maximum is 3,600 m², which caps the residential footprint including the farm house and accessory buildings.

There are no East Delta market figures to quote — from any legitimate source. SnapStats covers only 14 communities and its Delta coverage is North Delta only; South Delta (Ladner / Tsawwassen / East Delta) is NOT covered, and North Delta numbers must never be presented as East Delta numbers.
The Boundary Bay Dyke Trail runs on the south side of the farm area, from 17A Avenue to Mud Bay in Boundary Bay Regional Park (Metro Vancouver).

Streamside rules reach farm ditches. The City requires checks for flood protection requirements, the Riparian Areas Regulation and streamside rules before development near regulated water bodies — and all Delta properties within 30 m of a stream, including sloughs and ditches, fall within the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area.

Streets, schools and getting around East Delta

items.t: Schools: catchments are address-based in SD37 (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12, no middle-school tier), checked in the SD37 School Locator. No sample address for this sub-area was run in the base research, so no catchment result is stated for East Delta: UNVERIFIED — run the specific address.

Services are in Ladner, not in East Delta itself: Ladner Pioneer Library, 4683 51 Street (Fraser Valley Regional Library), serves the area, and Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, is Fraser Health's community hospital for Delta, next to Ladner Exchange. No City park, recreation centre or shopping centre inside East Delta itself was confirmed on an official source.
The Boundary Bay Dyke Trail runs from 17A Avenue to Mud Bay in Boundary Bay Regional Park (Metro Vancouver), on the south side of the Delta farm area.

Market context: NONE stated. SnapStats covers North Delta, but East Delta sits on the Ladner/South Delta side and the SnapStats FVR September 2026 report contains no East Delta sub-area row and no Ladner/South Delta community section — North Delta numbers must never be presented as East Delta numbers, and none is presented here.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in East Delta

items.t: The farm rules govern most of this ground — read these first: In the A1 Agriculture zone (Delta Zoning Bylaw, s. 10.10.8), subdivision is permitted only where it complies with the OCP and has been approved under the Agricultural Land Commission Act if applicable, and the minimum lot size that may be created by subdivision is 8 ha, with a home site severance exception under ALC policy. The A1 zone provides one farm house per lot, a farm house maximum of 500 m², a farm home plate maximum of 3,600 m², one secondary suite inside the farm house, and one accessory farm dwelling unit of maximum 90 m² on lots of 40 ha or less or 186 m² on lots over 40 ha. A2 (s. 10.20.6) also sets an 8 ha subdivision minimum; A3 (s. 10.30.6) does not permit subdivision.

ALR stratification bar: an ALR residence cannot be stratified — ALC Information Bulletin 09, s. 6; Strata Property Act s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act s. 21(1). That is the legal reason the farm belt produces freehold farm product, not strata townhouses. The ALC generally allows no more than one residence per ALR parcel; a principal residence built without an ALC application is capped at 500 m²; a secondary suite is permitted only inside the principal residence if local bylaws allow it; and one additional detached residence is permitted up to 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less or up to 186 m² on parcels over 40 ha — anything beyond that needs ALC approval.

Farm status thresholds — full three-tier form: $2,500 in farm sales on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 plus 5% of the land value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by October 31. A flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR and is never used here.

Community plan: Official Community Plan 2024, "Housing Our Future," Bylaw No. 8400 — a single consolidated plan with NO lettered schedules — applies to the whole area; its Agriculture policies (OCP s. 2.6, informed by the City's 2023 Agricultural Plan) apply to Delta's agricultural land, and the urban part is covered by the same consolidated Land Use Plan. Any page citing a Tsawwassen-style "Schedule D.1 of Bylaw No. 8400" for Delta land is conflating the old Bylaw 3950 schedules with the current plan — flagged wherever met.

SSMUH / suites (Delta, as the City states it): Delta's small-scale multi-unit housing amendments were adopted June 24, 2024 (Bylaws 8394 + 8395), allowing combinations of single detached dwellings, duplex dwellings, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites where the zoning applies — urban-edge context, not a farm-belt or townhome-complex rule.

: Form B diligence under Strata Property Act s. 59 (monthly fees, amounts owing, approved special levies, CRF balance, insurance summary, with depreciation report and bylaws attached; within 7 days, maximum $35 plus up to 25 cents per page); depreciation reports every five years for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024 (a sub-5-lot strata sits UNDER that threshold); CRF minimum 10% of the operating budget since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022 — flag every directory "rentals not allowed" line void in-entry; only 55+ age bylaws valid since November 24, 2022 (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2 + May 1, 2023 exemptions).

Wells and septic: search the well in the provincial GWELLS registry (wells built before the Water Sustainability Act may not be in it); Fraser Health requires a building with indoor plumbing not connected to a community sewer to use an onsite sewage system complying with the Sewerage System Regulation, designed and installed by an Authorized Person.

Flood and streamside: the City requires checks for flood protection requirements, the Riparian Areas Regulation and streamside rules before development near regulated water bodies; the City is raising sections of the Boundary Bay dike between 72 Street and 88 Street with provincial grant funding.

Taxes and rebates (any townhome purchase on the urban edge): PTT 1% to $200,000, 2% to $2,000,000, 3% above $2,000,000, plus a further 2% on the residential portion above $3,000,000 — a page's "Over $3M — 5%" row is a compression of that 3% + 2% and is flagged as such, never a single rate. Exemptions: first-time buyers (exempt on the first $500,000 at $835,000 or less, partial to $860,000); newly built home exemption (full to $1,100,000, eliminated at $1,150,000). FTHB GST rebate — Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026 per CRA News No. 122 (100% to $1M, phasing to $1.5M, maximum $50,000, agreements March 20, 2025–2031); New Housing Rebate 36% / maximum $6,300 / $350,000–$450,000; HBP $60,000; FHSA $40,000 lifetime / $8,000 per year; CMHC premiums 0.6%–4.5%. Delta property taxes were due July 2, 2026, with 5% after that date and a further 5% after September 2, 2026. The Vancouver Empty Homes Tax (3%) is VANCOUVER ONLY and does not apply here.

blocks.text: Lots and land in East Delta
Fee-simple farm parcels

items.t: Most East Delta land is farm or rural freehold rather than strata, mainly under A1 Agriculture zoning (one farm house per lot). Existing farm parcels vary in size and are confirmed parcel by parcel; no "typical" East Delta parcel size is published by any official source: UNCONFIRMED.

Subdivision math that governs any new lot: in the A1 zone (s. 10.10.8), subdivision is permitted only where it complies with the OCP and has been approved under the Agricultural Land Commission Act if applicable, and the minimum lot size that may be created by subdivision is 8 ha, with a home site severance exception under ALC policy. A2 (s. 10.20.6) likewise sets an 8 ha minimum lot area created by subdivision; A3 (s. 10.30.6) does not permit subdivision.

Residential footprint on a farm parcel: one farm house per lot, farm house maximum 500 m², farm home plate maximum 3,600 m², one secondary suite inside the farm house, and one accessory farm dwelling unit of maximum 90 m² on lots of 40 ha or less or 186 m² on lots over 40 ha (A1 zone details as the research states them).

Urban edge: East Ladner parcels take the RS and RD zones in the Ladner ladder, assigned parcel by parcel on the City's zoning maps — the zone on a specific edge parcel is a City-map read, not a sub-area assumption.

Servicing: farm properties not connected to a community sewer use onsite sewage systems — Fraser Health requires a building with indoor plumbing that is not connected to a community sewer to use an onsite system complying with the Sewerage System Regulation, designed and installed by an Authorized Person; a property's well is searched in the provincial GWELLS registry, noting wells built before the Water Sustainability Act came into force may not be in the registry. Per-parcel water/sewer status: UNCONFIRMED until checked.

items.t: Subdivision and servicing — process, adoption HELD UNCONFIRMED: A City council report (January 24, 2024) presents the Delta Development and Subdivision Standards Bylaw No. 8288, 2024 to repeal and replace Bylaw No. 7162, 2015, made under s. 506 of the Local Government Act to regulate works and services on subdivision — highways, water, sanitary sewers, drainage and other services.

Streamside / flood diligence: All Delta properties within 30 m of a stream, including sloughs and ditches, fall within the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area; the City requires checks for flood protection requirements and the Riparian Areas Regulation before development near regulated water bodies, and is raising sections of the Boundary Bay dike between 72 Street and 88 Street with provincial grant funding.

: Subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified — strata plans cause subdivision in the ALR (ALC Information Bulletin 09, s. 6; Strata Property Act, s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act, s. 21(1)). Residence caps: principal residence 500 m² or less total floor area; a secondary suite only within the principal residence; one additional residence of 90 m² or less (parcels 40 ha or less) or 186 m² or less (parcels over 40 ha).

PTT exemptions: First-time buyers: no tax on the first $500,000 (maximum saving $8,000), full exemption at fair market value $835,000 or less, partial to $860,000. Newly Built Home Exemption: full to $1,100,000, eliminated at $1,150,000 — it is a new-HOME exemption; bare-land eligibility beyond the documented vacant-land refund route is UNCONFIRMED.

: Form B within 7 days of request, maximum $35 + 25¢/page; depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2, with the May 1, 2023 exemptions). A "45+" listing line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw.

blocks.text: Good to know about East Delta

items.t: The name itself is the first trap: "East Delta" sounds like a North Delta counterpart, but the ground is Ladner's farm belt — pricing, statistics and services all run through Ladner / South Delta, and North Delta numbers must never be presented as East Delta numbers.

Check the home plate, not just the house: the A1 farm home plate maximum is 3,600 m², capping the residential footprint including the farm house and accessory buildings — a buyer planning a large house-plus-barn footprint hits this before the 500 m² house cap.

The old East Ladner Area Plan no longer exists as a schedule: it was Schedule B.1 under Bylaw No. 3950; the consolidated OCP, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), folded the former area plans into a single Land Use Plan, and any citation of a lettered schedule under Bylaw 8400 — including "Schedule D.1 of Bylaw 8400" — is an error.

Streamside rules reach farm ditches: a farm lot's ditch can put part of the parcel inside the 30 m Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area, limiting building and subdivision work there.

faq.q: Who can help me buy or sell in East Delta?
faq.a: Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, works across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361 or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in East Delta?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in East Delta?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: Are there any condos in East Delta?
faq.a: No verified apartment-condo building exists in East Delta on any source checked — count 0.

faq.q: Can a farm parcel here have a second dwelling?
faq.a: Under ALC rules, one principal residence plus, in some cases, one additional detached residence up to 90 m² (40 ha or less) or 186 m² (over 40 ha); Delta's A1 zone allows one accessory farm dwelling unit within those same limits.

faq.q: What is the smallest new farm lot that can be created?
faq.a: 8 ha in the A1 zone, subject to OCP compliance and Agricultural Land Commission Act approval where applicable (Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, s. 10.10.8).

faq.q: Why can't ALR residences just be stratified into condos?
faq.a: ALC Information Bulletin 09, s. 6, treats strata plans as plans that cause subdivision in the ALR, so stratification is not an ordinary route for ALR residences.
Catchments are address-based in SD37 and no sample-address result is published for this sub-area — check the exact address in the SD37 School Locator: UNVERIFIED for any specific farm address.

faq.q: Is East Delta a real neighbourhood I can search by?
faq.a: Price and compare any property as what it legally is: an ALR farm parcel or an urban East Ladner lot under the consolidated OCP, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024).

faq.q: Can I stratify or subdivide a farm parcel here?
faq.a: Subdivision in A1 needs a minimum 8 ha new lot, OCP compliance and ALC Act approval where applicable; and an ALR residence cannot be stratified at all (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)).

faq.q: Can a farm parcel have a second dwelling?
faq.a: In some cases: one principal residence (capped at 500 m² without an ALC application) plus one additional detached residence up to 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less or 186 m² on larger parcels; Delta's A1 zone also allows one accessory farm dwelling unit within those size limits.
